title: Popcorn
desc: Two strangers with pent-up issues meet inside a mall elevator that gets stuck for 18 hours, where their hostility towards each other causes friction.

title: Apaharan
desc: Ajay, an aspiring policeman, borrows money from a moneylender to pursue his dream. However, he is unable to repay the loan on time and decides to be a part of a kidnapping scheme.

title: Satyaprem Ki Katha
desc: Satyaprem tries hard to prove himself as a worthy person and restore the faith in the love of Khata, who is overwhelmed by her breakup.

title: Mili
desc: Mili, a young woman, accidentally gets stuck in a walk-in freezer at her workplace. Racing against time, she must find a way to survive.

title: Jabariya Jodi
desc: Abhay, a righteous thug, forcefully kidnaps grooms who demand dowry and later marries them off. Babli, his childhood sweetheart, re-enters his life and changes his priorities.

title: The Power of 3 Jai Luv Kush
desc: Separated at childhood, identical triplets, who find their calling in life, reunite after one of them kidnaps other two brothers for his own purpose.
